intro: Across Westfall, Dust Devils leave charged grit in their wake. Mages value this debris as a reagent for enchanting parchment and binding messaging spells into scrolls.

p: Dust Devils sweep across Westfall’s plains as violent whirlwinds. When one is struck down, the living storm collapses into charged dust and grit called Dust Devil Debris. A faint trace of the elemental vortex remains in the residue. In Stormwind, arcane practitioners such as Collin Mauren prize it for specialized sorcery. Infused into enchanted ink and parchment, the grit helps a wizard bind an airy messaging spell to a scroll, carrying words across the kingdom.
